verses.1: And the leaders of the people settled in Jerusalem. The rest of the people brought their offerings, so that one of the twelve could be brought to Jerusalem, the holy city, and to the seven cities.
verses.2: And the people blessed all those who were willing to settle in Jerusalem.
verses.3: And these are the leaders of the land, who will live in Jerusalem and in the cities of Judah. Each man will have his own territory within those cities. These are the priests, the Levites, the singers, and the sons of Solomon’s servants.
verses.4: And in Jerusalem, the descendants of Judah and the descendants of Benjamin would live together. They were the descendants of Judah: Atiyah son of Uzziah, Zekherya son of Atiyah, Amariah son of Atiyah, Shaphtiyah son of Amariah, and Mahalalel son of Japhia. They were the descendants of Pares.
verses.5: And his actions were good; he was blessed, son of all who see, son of Hazayah, son of Adaya, son of Yoyarib, son of Zekhariyah, son of Hishloni.
verses.6: All the children of Perath who live in Jerusalem are four hundred and sixty-seven men.
verses.7: And these are the sons of Benyamin: Salu, son of Mashlam, son of Yo’ed, son of Pdaya, son of Kolaya, son of Ma’aseya, son of Itiel, and son of Yeshayah.
verses.8: And after him was Gabai Salai, who had eighty and twenty years.
verses.9: And Yoel son of Zichri shall be appointed as their ruler. And Yehuda son of Sinuah will rule over the city from a new position.
verses.10: Among the priests, Yedaya ben Yo’yarib will be chosen.
verses.11: Shriya ben-Hilkia, ben-Meshulam, ben-Tzadok, ben-Meriot, ben-Ahitub. He was a man who lived in the house of God.
verses.12: And their workers in the house were Shmonah, Eshron, Adaya, Ben-Yeroham, Ben-Palliya, Ben-Amtsi, Ben-Zekhriya, Ben-Fashhur, and Ben-Malkiyah.
verses.13: And his brothers were forty in number: two of them were heads of their families. Also, Amashsai, son of Azarel, and Ahzai, son of Meshilmoeth, and Immer.
verses.14: And among them were two hundred and fifty commanders of troops, and Zabdiyel, the son of the great ones, was appointed to command them.
verses.15: And from the descendants of Eliphaz, son of Esau, son of Jair, son of Betuel.
verses.16: And I shall rest, and Yozavad will carry out the most important task related to the house of God, from among the leaders of the Levites.
verses.17: And Mattaniah son of Michah, son of Zabdi, son of Asaf was the first to begin praying. After him were his brothers: Abda son of Shammu, son of Galaal, son of Yedutun.
verses.18: All the Levites in the holy city are fifty in number.
verses.19: And the guards were Akub Talmon and his men. They guarded the gates, one hundred seventy-two in total.
verses.20: And the rest of Israel, the priests, were living in all the cities of Judah. Each man lived in his own territory.
verses.21: And the tenants sit on stools and chairs, and they stand over the tenants.
verses.22: And the leaders of the Levites in Jerusalem were Ezi ben-Bani, ben-Hashbayya, ben-Matanya, and ben-Mika. They were sons of Asaf, those who served against the Temple of God.
verses.23: Because the king’s command is upon them, and there is trust in those who carry out it day by day.
verses.24: And Pethiah son of Mesizavael, one of the sons of Zerah son of Judah, was appointed by the king to handle all matters related to the people.
verses.25: And in the courtyards of their houses, among the descendants of Judah, will dwell the people of the fourth generation and their daughters. Also, in Dibon and its surrounding areas, as well as in Ekavtzael and its courtyards.
verses.26: And in life and in death, and in the house of Palt.
verses.27: And in the courtyard of Shu’al, and in the valley of Seba, and in its daughters.
verses.28: And in its branches and in its leaves.
verses.29: And in Rimon and Tsar’ah and Yarmut.
verses.30: They captured their livestock and their houses. They also captured their women and children. They camped from Be’er Sheva to Giyon Hinnom.
verses.31: And the sons of Benyamin from Giv’ah, from Kmemash; and Ayah and Beit El, and their daughters.
verses.32: Their answers were like the answers of those who are in darkness.
verses.33: The wall of Ramah was broken.
verses.34: A friend of birds is a fool.
verses.35: Lod and Ono are the sons of the harashim.
verses.36: And from the Levites, Yehuda was divided into two groups.
